===Overview===
__NOTOC__
The Argent Sword were raised by [[Raise Second Urizen Army|Senate motion]] proposed by '''Herminius of the House of the Wanderer''', then Senator for [[Zenith]], during the Spring Equinox 387YE as a result of an [[A_box_for_a_sword#The_Blade_of_Finest_Silver|offer]] made by [[Callidus]]. Mustering completed in a single season, shortly before the Summer Solstice 387YE. 

The second Urizen general leads the Argent Sword army, and is appointed (or re-appointed) at the Winter Solstice each year.

==Army Quality : [[Army_qualities#Foraging|Raiders]]==
The soldiers of the [[Realm#Autumn|Iron Labyrinth]] are rough and ready, with an eye for potential profit. The Argent Sword can be unleashed to focus on coin over conquest to make the general wealthy.

===Bound to the Argent Tontine===
The Argent Sword is a part of an ongoing contract with [[Callidus]], the Sovereign-Lord of the City of Chains. The army can only benefit from [[Army#Resupply|resupply]], natural or otherwise, whilst the eternal enjoys the [[Alignment#Amity|amity]] of the Conclave. In addition, due to its nature, it is only possible to [[Army#Rituals|enchant]] the army with Autumn magic.

Should Callidus be placed under [[Alignment#Enmity|enmity]], there may be some legal complications, but given the mercenaries are not from any one city, it would only pose a problem if the Conclave were to place a significant number of Autumn eternals under enmity.
